root_causes: Early high-fidelity verification packets were individually affordable but critical-obligation reserves still used output-only constants, leaving later frontiers unverified.
A valid reflexive relation whose bound input and output text are identical was rejected because both tuple endpoints were marked bound.

architectural_delta.horizon_reserve: Critical reserves for future extraction, verification, and JOIN obligations now include deterministic prompt context plus completion bounds.
architectural_delta.adaptive_samples: No fixed one-sample rule is introduced; high fidelity remains available only when its marginal EVC is positive and its full downstream reserve is feasible.
architectural_delta.reflexive_projection: An identical subject/value tuple may project the value slot only when the target relation is certified, the endpoint is bound, and the value type matches the compiled output type.

execution_order: development canary 5 if causal gate passes
paired control/HARA Shadow-C20 without between-arm inspection if Smoke-A passes
stop_condition: Continue generic no-training diagnosis and iteration after any development failure. Stop only on the full preregistered HARA gate plus committed safe-stop report, or before the next call would exceed the shared 2000-attempt/2000000-token hard cap.
